top_strength: Handled a complex commercial office move (17-line inventory, two-day packing-then-move schedule, building access details) smoothly and proactively gave both a with-packing and without-packing price so the customer could compare, while setting up an easy text/email path to collect photos for a more accurate follow-up estimate.
coaching_note: The $4,596/$2,520 price landed without ever mentioning No Worries Damage Coverage, Meet Your Mover, or the On-Time Guarantee - lead with at least one of those differentiators before quoting price on a job this size so the number lands with trust already built.
phone_presence_notes: Polite and patient (e.g., 'no worries, take your time') with a genuinely positive customer sign-off, but delivery is transactional with frequent hesitation/filler and the customer's name used only once.
audio_review_reason: Transcript has garbled pricing numbers (e.g., '494000 got it for five' for $4,596) and heavy filler/hesitation during the rate mix-up - worth an audio check to confirm the price was actually communicated clearly.
